name: LLMHound P12: AI services with Entra SSO AZApp and host execution surface
description: Execution-capable AI services delegating authentication to an Entra AZApp, highlighting SSO-reachable compute hosts.
query:
MATCH (s:LLMHound_AIService)-[:LLMHound_AuthenticatesVia]->(a:AZApp)
MATCH (s)-[:LLMHound_ObservedAt]->(h)
WHERE NOT h:LLMHound_NetworkEndpoint
  AND any(e IN coalesce(s.exec_surface, []) WHERE e IN ['code_kernel', 'job_submit', 'code_eval'])
RETURN s, a, h
LIMIT 100
